title: 应用里「新建报表」保存时不带软件包，而新建视图会带上应用的包：两条路径对同一操作做法不一致
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYkkwuF6UuFtu85Yd5H

④ sub-issue of #36890 · Source: #36906's os-dev report 7157110199, open question 1. Seat repo:objectstack#4 ruled 「A for this card; file the B card」: two paths for one operation disagree, so the report side follows the view rule. Part of #36890.

## 维护者速读

- 在应用里用报表列表的「新建」建一张报表，保存时不指定软件包，于是它成了环境级元数据，不属于任何包。在同一个应用里新建视图，却会存进应用的包（可写包存本包，只读包存它的定制包）。
- #36906（PR #37226）已经让从 Studio 打开的新建报表页存进包里；应用自己的「新建」入口还是老做法。
- 改法：让应用自己的新建报表也按视图的规则决定存到哪个包。这会改变以后所有应用里新建报表的存放位置，已有的报表不动。

## What

- The app's own new-report save (the reports index's New, outside Studio) resolves the app's package the way views do: `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage`, which gives the package when it is writable and its `.custom` pair through the ensure door otherwise, falling back package-less exactly where views do. Use the same `saveAndPublishInPackage` path #36906 added for the Studio leg, so the two legs share one rule.
- Pins:
  - from an app on a writable package, a new report names `packageId: P`;
  - on an installed (read-only) app it names the pair;
  - CONTROL: a refusing ensure door falls back as views do.
  - Replace the existing pin that holds the old package-less behaviour outside Studio (added by #36906), and name it in the PR.
- Also reword `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage`'s console warning ("the view is saved naming no package") so it names the type it is saving (noted in 7157110199).

## Done when

- A report made from any app's New lands in the same package a view made there would, and Studio's report list shows it.

## Notes

- Size S, priority p2.
- **Blocked-by:** #36906 (PR #37226), which adds the Studio leg this card extends.
- Data placement changes for new reports only; existing reports are not moved.
